description: Installs the polymath-jage Codebase Manager globally.

comments.use_case: Execute this tool when an AI agent needs to manage, version, or organize a codebase effectively. Once installed, the agent can navigate to any directory and run 'jage init' to establish a structural semantic map, and 'jage push' to dynamically deduplicate and synchronize the AST hashes across the Swarm Architecture.
comments.advantages: Replaces legacy tools like Git by perfectly mapping semantic logic rather than plain text diffs, and utilizes a completely zero-dependency execution environment.
